PAYMENT AND PERFORMANCE BOND

Bond No. SB-2026-441907
Penal Sum: $8,940,000.00

KNOW ALL PERSONS BY THESE PRESENTS, that we, KESTREL RIDGE CONSTRUCTION LLC, an Idaho limited liability company, whose principal place of business is 3410 Nampa Boulevard, Boise, Idaho 83704, as Principal (the "Principal"), and GRANITE SHIELD SURETY COMPANY, a Nebraska corporation authorized to do business in the State of Idaho and appearing on the United States Department of the Treasury's Listing of Certified Companies, as Surety (the "Surety"), are held and firmly bound unto ADA COUNTY SCHOOL DISTRICT NO. 3, a political subdivision of the State of Idaho, as Obligee (the "Obligee"), in the penal sum of EIGHT MILLION NINE HUNDRED FORTY THOUSAND AND 00/100 DOLLARS ($8,940,000.00), for the payment of which the Principal and the Surety bind themselves, their heirs, executors, administrators, successors, and assigns, jointly and severally, firmly by these presents.

WHEREAS, the Principal has entered into a written contract with the Obligee dated August 3, 2026, for the construction of the Willow Creek Middle School Replacement, Project No. 2026-11 (the "Contract"), which Contract is incorporated by reference and made a part of this bond;

NOW, THEREFORE, the condition of this obligation is such that:

1. Performance.

If the Principal promptly and faithfully performs the Contract, including all work, guarantees, and warranty obligations, and pays all sums the Principal is obligated to pay under it, then this obligation is void; otherwise it remains in full force and effect.

2. Payment.

The Principal and the Surety are jointly and severally bound to pay all claimants, as that term is defined in Idaho Code § 54-1927, for all labor and material furnished in the prosecution of the work under the Contract. This bond is given pursuant to Idaho Code §§ 54-1925 through 54-1930 and is subject to those provisions as if fully set forth here, and any provision of this bond that conflicts with the statute is deemed amended to conform to it.

3. Surety's Obligation on Default.

Whenever the Obligee declares the Principal in default under the Contract and has performed the Obligee's own obligations under it, the Surety shall promptly, and at the Surety's expense, elect in writing within thirty (30) days after the Obligee's written notice of default to: (a) arrange for the Principal, with the Obligee's consent, to perform and complete the Contract; (b) undertake to perform and complete the Contract itself, through its agents or independent contractors; (c) obtain bids from qualified contractors acceptable to the Obligee, arrange for a contract between the selected bidder and the Obligee, and pay to the Obligee the amount by which the cost of completion exceeds the balance of the Contract price; or (d) waive its right to perform and complete, and, after investigation, either tender payment to the Obligee of the amount for which the Surety is liable or deny liability in whole or in part with written notice of the reasons. If the Surety does not proceed under this Section within thirty (30) days after notice, the Surety is deemed in default on this bond seven days after the Obligee gives written notice of that failure, and the Obligee is entitled to enforce any remedy available to it.

4. Claims Procedure for Claimants.

A claimant who has a direct contractual relationship with a subcontractor of the Principal, but no contractual relationship express or implied with the Principal, may sue on this bond only if the claimant gives written notice to the Principal within ninety (90) days after the date on which the claimant last furnished labor or material, stating with substantial accuracy the amount claimed and the party to whom the material was furnished. No suit may be commenced after one (1) year from the date on which the claimant last furnished labor or material, or as otherwise provided by Idaho Code § 54-1929.

5. Limit of Liability.

The aggregate liability of the Surety under this bond, for both the performance and the payment obligations combined, shall not exceed the penal sum stated above, and the Surety's liability is reduced by any payment made in good faith under this bond. No right of action accrues on this bond to any person or entity other than the Obligee and the claimants described in Section 4, or their heirs, executors, administrators, successors, and assigns.

6. Notice and Changes to the Contract.

The Surety waives notice of any change, alteration, extension of time, addition, or omission in the Contract or in the work to be performed, and agrees that no such change discharges the Surety or affects its obligations under this bond. Every notice to the Surety shall be in writing and delivered to Granite Shield Surety Company, Claims Department, 1990 Farnam Street, Suite 800, Omaha, Nebraska 68102.

7. Governing Law and Venue.

This bond is governed by the laws of the State of Idaho. Any proceeding on this bond shall be brought in the District Court of the Fourth Judicial District of the State of Idaho, in and for Ada County, or in the United States District Court for the District of Idaho.

SIGNED AND SEALED this 12th day of August, 2026.

PRINCIPAL: KESTREL RIDGE CONSTRUCTION LLC
